# Er Genmab tilbage som vinderaktie? Kursen er steget tæt på 100 pct. på få måneder

**Feed**: borsen-podcast  
**Published**: 2026-10-28  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Danish Børsen Investor episode, mainly about Genmab's roughly 100% rally since June. The rally came after strong trial results for Epkinly and Rina-S, which ease fears about its upcoming patent expiry; Merus data due in Q4 is the last key test. The panel also discusses Anthropic's planned Nasdaq IPO with scepticism about its roughly $2tn valuation, and reviews the All Star portfolio: Danske Bank and Ericsson are held, Ericsson is on the replacement bench, and Meta is likely to be sold after it announced a large share issue.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 GMAB — Genmab | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Strong momentum (~100% since June) after Epkinly and Rina-S data; Merus Q4 data is the next catalyst. Nina will look at it.

#### Reasoning

Guest journalist Tom Frost says the patent-cliff risk has been substantially reduced by recent trials: Rina-S is wholly owned, with peak sales estimated at $6bn by Nordea. Remaining risks are the Merus data due in Q4, regulatory approvals and proof that its own sales force can deliver. Panel member Nina says she will look at the stock; Jesper calls the sector high-risk.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Merus Q4 trial results disappoint
- if approvals of Epkinly/Rina-S are delayed
- if commercial launch costs outpace revenue

> *"Men jeg vil kigge på den. Jeg synes, det er superspændende."*

---

### 🟡 DANSKE — Danske Bank | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Kept in the All Star portfolio; Jesper expects a strong Q3 report tomorrow with solid underlying trends.

#### Reasoning

Jesper keeps the position: net interest income and fee income are healthy, loan losses limited and productivity rising. He expects the discount to peers to narrow. Risks are sector weakness from French/Belgian debt worries, a proposed extra 7% Danish bank tax and regulatory risk around risk-weighted assets (as seen at Nordea).

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Q3 report disappoints
- if the Danish bank tax increase is implemented harshly
- if regulators challenge its risk-weight models

> *"Så jeg tror, det bliver et forluftigt regnskab igen."*

---

### 🟡 ERIC-B — Ericsson | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Up 22% in the portfolio on strong execution, but on the replacement bench and watchlist.

#### Reasoning

Jesper credits very strong operational execution in the quarter, but rising input prices (linked to Nvidia) are overwhelming customers. The lag in passing costs on will hurt into 2027. He keeps it for now but may swap it for Sydbank or International Petroleum.

#### Sell Triggers

- if input-cost pressure cannot be passed on to customers
- if a better candidate such as Sydbank is chosen

> *"Men Erik er på udskiftningsbækken her næste tid."*

---

### 🟠 SYDB — Sydbank (AL Sydbank) | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Jesper names it a potential replacement candidate for the portfolio; merger synergies ahead.

#### Reasoning

Jesper calls the merged AL Sydbank 'a rather exciting company' with plenty of synergies on the horizon and solid fundamentals. The portfolio already holds one bank, so it is a candidate rather than a decided buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if merger synergies fail to materialise
- if Danish bank tax increases

> *"Der er masser af synergier, der ligger ude i horisonten, og løsning ser fin ud."*

---

### 🟠 IPCO — International Petroleum | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Jesper intended to buy it for the portfolio; the stock has done well since.

#### Reasoning

Jesper had wanted International Petroleum in the portfolio, but the trade was never executed. He notes it has performed well and mentions oil exposure as a replacement option for Ericsson.

#### Sell Triggers

- if oil prices fall sharply

> *"Men det var International Petroleum, vi skulle have købt ind i portføljen her."*

---

### 🔴 META — Meta | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Position down 17.8%. A $95bn raise with no fixed timing will weigh on the stock like a blanket; Nina likely to exit.

#### Reasoning

Nina praises the report (+26% revenue), the models and the outlook, but says the $95bn raise ($35bn first tranche, then $60bn, non-voting C shares, dribbled out with no fixed timing) creates an overhang. Jesper adds that the valuation is stretched and cash flow has turned negative because of capex. Nina reluctantly concludes they should probably exit.

#### Sell Triggers

- n/a - exit thesis; would reverse if the raise is cancelled or its timing clarified

> *"Ja, vi må jo nok liste os ud. Men jeg er jo ikke meget for det."*

---

### 🟡 GN — GN Store Nord | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Long a laggard in the portfolio, now up ~30% in recent months and near its 117 entry price.

#### Reasoning

Host Simon notes the stock has finally gained momentum after years of collecting dust and suggests it may now 'unfold its potential'. This is a host comment, not explicit conviction from the panel.

#### Sell Triggers

- if momentum fades back below the recent rally levels

> *"Så det kan være, at det er nu, at den endelig udfolder sit potentiale."*

---
